scenarios: a request starts from a dirty worktree (edited tracked file, untracked draft, tracked .env) and runs on its chosen plan; RequestSnapshotRecorded pins the exact starting repository
replaying the decision's hard-eligible openai/gpt-5 alternative is REPLAY_NOT_ADMITTED until policy sets eval.replay ALLOW; the chosen plan is REPLAY_PLAN_CHOSEN, an unknown one REPLAY_PLAN_UNKNOWN
admitted, the replay runs as its own task through the Gateway (the provider sees gpt-5) in a scratch repository under the Core's replays/: dirty state restored, .env sanitized away, no remote
its forge.issue.read attempt is refused and the fake forge receives no request; the original repository's files, refs, worktrees and status are byte-for-byte unchanged
the request record shows the replay OBSERVED with plan, snapshot commit, registry generation and review_isolated ceiling, observed_minor its cost, the estimate still an estimate
a deleted snapshot ref makes a replay REPLAY_REVISION_MISMATCH; a newer registry generation makes it REPLAY_STALE; on Windows (no host sandbox) it is SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE and nothing is taken
audit: DOCUMENTED-ONLY before: the request record labelled an ESTIMATED direct-frontier counterfactual and an observed_label that was always NOT_EXECUTED; nothing pinned a request's starting repository and nothing could execute an alternative.
proof: Real Core, terminal broker, host sandbox, signed registry and scripted OpenAI-compatible provider: an alternative plan replays offline as its own task on the request's exact snapshot, isolated (sanitized scratch clone, no remote, review_isolated ceiling, forge refused), and the request record reads its outcome as an observed counterfactual distinct from the estimate.
negative_proof: EPR-FI-011 mutations: disabling sanitization fails the test (.env travels); replaying under the trusted profile with egress and secret operations fails it (the fake forge receives the request with the token).
limitations: Every replay recomputes verification in isolation (deterministic evidence is not reused); replays start on request — automatic exploration and propensity belong to EPR-012; pre-existing dirty files count in a request's candidate diff (DI-1) as before.

ci.note: every job green on macOS, Linux and Windows on the first attempt; the change also carries a test-only fix making the m6_2 capacity-ticket test wait for the held request instead of a fixed two seconds
